mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS rising above 12-month averages fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances, or the correlation between the joint signal and 20-day returns is negative (Rank IC < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 235), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 235 AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing output and economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE has increased, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 400000), strong consumer spending and housing activity signal peak economic conditions that lead to overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1-month rise in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth that supports corporate revenue expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising CPI periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
